planes.name: plane-06
planes.eave_note: Drip edge at top of dark fascia (lower edge of fascia explicitly excluded by spec).

ambiguities: The lower canopy has a prominent dark fascia. Per the 'Not on the fascia board lower edge' rule, the bottom of this dark band cannot be the scored eave. I marked the top of this dark fascia as the drip edge/eave for plane-06, and the planter wall sitting above it as a separate parapet plane (plane-05). Small agaves on plane-05 are individually <15% so the plane continues through them, noted generally in occlusions.
